title: Integer to double and double to float round to nearest
verdict: round to nearest even; overflow to ±inf
description: `Int64` to `Float64` rounds to the nearest double (2⁵³ + 1 is 2⁵³). `Float64` to `Float32` rounds to the nearest float, overflows to inf and underflows to 0.
reference: The conversions between integers and doubles are opaque constants with proved properties (`SubstraitLean/Conversions.lean`), the same in every profile; `fp32` arithmetic is refused until #417.

provenance.notes: `sverify_dev.probe_polars` runs each expression on edge cases (0, ±1, ±2, 3, ±7, the bounds of the integer width; 0.5, ±2.5, 7, 1e308, ±inf, NaN; NULL), one row at a time, and compares each row with Lean's outcome of the Substrait call under each candidate option (`substrait-check --outcomes`). Observations are Polars programs whose result is recorded as it is. Polars 2.1.0 (Python), Rust crates at tag py-2.1.0 (commit 7f902bd3), on macOS arm64.
